issues.title: Ingest Hempstead County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $23,211,651 across 50 funds. The largest: County General ($6,221,110), County Road ($4,908,709), Capital Improvement/Courthouse Fund ($3,000,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Arkansas Historic Preservation Grant
issues.detail: Ordinance 2025-18 (p. 76, scanned) appropriates $23,299.08 for this fund; the budget detail report (p. 67) shows $288,299.08, which is what its categories add to. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
